lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Cesar Lim is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Cesar Lim is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Cesar kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Cesar's gone." Daniela looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Cesar." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Cameron blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Intimidating Presence (Level 1). You don't have to fight. Most people decide not to, just looking at you.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Bodyguard (Level 1). In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Cesar Lim, 41 days. The mantle passes to Cameron Schulz.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Cameron Schulz, 58 — a night security guard. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Cesar — and Cesar is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Silas, Daniela, Espen and 4 more speak for Cameron — "Cesar trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Cameron before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d111: Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
d111: You wake with a start — something is wrong.
d111: The gossip told you exactly where it would break. You arrived with the words ready. Peace, it turns out, is mostly showing up informed.
d111: Something wants to happen when you do... whatever you just did. (2/3)
d111: Learn the grudge first. Then walk into the middle of it.
